patent.title: Microfluidic devices
patent.abstract: Published application describing integrated microfluidic channel modules for handling immiscible fluids and droplets in biological, chemical and diagnostic assays.
claims: Claim 1 excerpt: at least one inlet module having at least one inlet channel adapted to carry at least one dispersed phase fluid
Claim 1 excerpt: said junction comprises a fluidic nozzle designed for flow focusing
Claim 1 excerpt: forms a plurality of highly uniform, monodisperse droplets in said continuous phase fluid
Claim 5: The microfluidic substrate of claim 4, wherein the coalescence apparatus comprises one or more electrodes that generate an electric field.
Claim 9 excerpt: said detection module comprising a detection apparatus for evaluating the contents or characteristics of the droplet or nanoreactor.
Claim 10: The microfluidic substrate of claim 9, wherein said detection apparatus comprises an optical or electrical detector.
